explanation: CompareTab takes an initialView and reports its view (defaults left out, keyed by value) through onViewChange for the URL. CompareGenesView gains summaryLayout="long" (one row per gene × population, sticky header) and summaryStartsOpen; the Compare tab starts its long summary folded as a bar showing the row count, opening to at most half the panel. The compare-set view keeps the wide table, open, with its tally.
